SPECULATIVE phase-2b E2E authoring complete (Run wf_ae9131ef-398): cc-sync/e2e @ 22cc18ed5882 plus the synckit in-process delivery harness cc-sync/synckit-harness @ f0e2ef3. The harness is stacked on delta1 2a201e3 and runs the real deliveryScheduler/deliverOnce/delivery-v2 store; its API is NewHarness/Kick/Status/WaitIdle, plus Manifests and RetryInterval. `go test -tags e2e -race -count=1 ./internal/e2e/ -v` on current pins: ALL PASS, 105 s, 0 races. NOT FINAL: go.work pins; the final runs happen on the final pushed pseudo-versions without go.work.
Acceptance matrix on current pins, in-process simulated hosts (real resident pipelines, real artifact stores, real reposync, real sessionrestore, the real synckit deliverer; fake orca/claude recorders):
- 1 source-unavailable recover: PASS (simulated; real-process is the realproc lane).
- 2 partial staging text+binary: PASS.
- 3 deletes/modes/symlinks: PASS.
- 4 new untracked source: PASS.
- 5 unpublished commits, incl. an unpublished-history LFS object offline: PASS.
- 6 ignored node_modules absent: PASS.
- 7 source unchanged (tree digest incl. .git): PASS.
- 8 >8 MiB transcript byte-exact: PASS.
- 9 missing/corrupt/interrupted parts → no ACK: PASS.
- 10 replay/idempotence: PASS.
- 11 relay A→B→C verbatim: PASS.
- 12 network policy on both endpoints × 6 states + receiver mid-batch refusal: PASS.
- 13 offline supersede + stale ACK refused: PASS.
- 14 7 d expiry without resurrection: PASS.
- 15 40 sessions over 12 worktrees/5 repos (priority/concurrency/cadence/dedup/zero payload): PASS.
- 16 multi-session Orca: PASS on the request side (the fake orca reply is canned; Orca-side behavior is covered by Orca's own e2e/QA).
- 17 sibling never rolls back: PASS.
- D7 mixed checkpoint: PASS.
- D13 code-only edit: PASS.
- D15 LFS: PASS. D15 sparse surfacing/--apply-sparse: NOT COVERED in E2E (unit-tested only); to add.
Follow-ups:
- (a) catalog.Retain same-CapturedAt tie-break yields a misleading ErrExpired (a product bug, worked around in tests), to fix in cc-sync.
- (b) synckit Harness.WaitIdle reads settled/status non-atomically, to fix in the synckit harness.
- (c) gosec findings in e2e fixtures under the build tag.
Remaining final steps:
- synckit final: fix stage → merge the rebased harness + fix (b) + re-measure CommitBatch (1m42 vs 24.7s).
- reposync final: review/fix/docs.
- cc-sync phase 2c: merge e2e, re-pin go.mod to the final pushed synckit/reposync SHAs, fix (a), add the sparse E2E, then run the E2E + realproc suites FINAL with GOWORK=off; then the cross-repo review.
